parameters.content:
## US Walkability, Transit & Bike Score Extractor

**Actor:** [US Walkability, Transit & Bike Score Extractor](https://apify.com/dataspryva/us-walkability-transit-and-bike-score-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/us-walkability-transit-and-bike-score-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `addresses` (array)
- `cities` (array)
- `neighborhoods` (array)
- `state` (string)
- `includeNeighborhoods` (boolean)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `address` (Address)
- `locationType` (Location Type)
- `city` (City)
- `state` (State)
- `zipCode` (Zip Code)
- `walkScore` (Walk Score)
- `walkDescription` (Walk Description)
- `transitScore` (Transit Score)
- `transitDescription` (Transit Description)
- `bikeScore` (Bike Score)
- `bikeDescription` (Bike Description)
- `nearbyAmenities` (Nearby Amenities)

description: Walk Score for a list of addresses: runs the US Walkability, Transit & Bike Score Extractor Apify Actor, returns address, locationType, walkScore, transitScore, bikeScore and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
